points.quote: `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (for example `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
`props: (internal) => ({...})` gives the default props. It uses helpers such as `internal.Text()`.
metadata holds ... the allowed `parent` flavours. (no children list, no glob patterns, no root role)
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>` ... `toModel: () => new ParagraphBlockModel()` creates the model instance.
The view is a Lit custom element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal`affine-paragraph`)` ... binds the flavour to that tag.
Each block package ... exposes two providers ... `StoreExtensionProvider` ... `ViewExtensionProvider` ... An editor or workspace then adds these providers to its store and view extension lists.
It has a `name`, an optional zod `schema` for its options, and an `effect()` that calls `effects()`. That call defines the custom elements.
